The\\n/// capacity is the literal at the single allocation site; `None` means the\\n/// expression is not an admitted chain and no `bytes_set` may consume it.\\npub(crate) fn owned_buffer_chain_capacity(expression: &Expr) -> Option<u64> {\\n    let mut links = 0usize;\\n    let mut current = expression;\\n    loop {\\n        let ExprKind::Call {\\n            name,\\n            type_arguments,\\n            args,\\n        } = &current.kind\\n        else {\\n            return None;\\n        };\\n        let op = by_name(name)?;\\n        if &args[0].kind else {\\n                    return None;\\n                };\\n                return (*capacity <= MAX_BUFFER_CAPACITY_BYTES).then_some(*capacity);\\n            }\\n            ByteOp::ZeroedBounded => {\\n                let (ExprKind::Usize(requested), ExprKind::Usize(bound)) =\\n                    (&args[0].kind, &args[1].kind)\\n                else {\\n It compares the argument\\n//! types and the result type structurally against the fixed shape of each\\n//! reopen, with no hashing or fingerprint; the original owning signature stays\\n//! the independent oracle in the parity controls below.\\nuse super::*;\\nuse crate::hir::funded::{self, FundedError, Reserve};\\nuse crate::hir::{\\n    ExpressionId, ResolvedExpr, ResolvedExprKind, ResolvedFunction, ResolvedStatement,\\n};\\nuse std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};\\nuse std::fmt::Write as _;\\n\\n/// Debit-before-grow byte sink for formatted text.\\nstruct Paid<'p, E> {\\n    bytes: Vec<u8>,\\n    reserve: Reserve<'p, E>,\\n    failure: Option<FundedError<E>>,\\n}\\n\\nimpl<E> std::fmt::Write for Paid<'_, E> {\\n    fn write_str(&mut self, text: &str) -> std::fmt::Result {\\n        match funded::grow(&mut self.bytes, text.len(), &mut *self.reserve) {\\n            Ok(()) => {\\n                self.bytes.extend_from_slice(text.as_bytes());\\n                Ok(())\\n            }\\n            Err(failure) => {\\n                self.failure = Some(failure);\\n                Err(std::fmt::Error)\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// Storage-free streaming substring matcher over a failure table.\\nstruct Find<'n> {\\n    needle: &'n [u8],\\n    table: &'n [usize],\\n    state: usize,\\n    found: bool,\\n}\\n\\nimpl std::fmt::Write for Find<'_> {\\n    fn write_str(&mut self, text: &str) -> std::fmt::Result {\\n        for &byte in text.as_bytes() {\\n            while self.state > 0 && self.needle[self.state] != byte {\\n                self.state = self.table[self.state - 1];\\n            }\\n            if self.needle[self.state] == byte {\\n                self.state += 1;\\n            }\\n            if self.state == self.needle.len() {\\n                self.found = true;\\n                return Err(std::fmt::Error);\\n            }\\n        }\\n        Ok(())\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// Paid needle and failure table for `format!(\\\"{owner:?}\\\")` containment.\\nstruct Needle {\\n    bytes: Vec<u8>,\\n    table: Vec<usize>,\\n}\\n\\nfn needle<E>(owner: &ValueId, reserve: Reserve<'_, E>) -> Result<Needle, FundedError<E>> {\\n    let mut sink = Paid {\\n        bytes: Vec::new(),\\n        reserve: &mut *reserve,\\n        failure: None,\\n    };\\n    if write!(sink, \\\"{owner:?}\\\").is_err() {\\n        return Err(sink\\n            .failure\\n            .unwrap_or(FundedError::Layout(\\\"owner debug text failed to format\\\")));\\n    }\\n    let bytes = sink.bytes;\\n    let mut table = Vec::new();\\n    funded::grow(&mut table, bytes.len(), reserve)?;\\n    let mut matched = 0usize;\\n    for at in 0..bytes.len() {\\n        if at == 0 {\\n            table.push(0);\\n            continue;\\n        }\\n        while matched > 0 && bytes[at] != bytes[matched] {\\n            matched = table[matched - i64]` and otherwise the compiler `Map`/`Set` nominal over exactly\\n/// the type arguments (identity is its text, as in `DeclarationId` equality).\\nfn typed_reopen_admitted(\\n    op: T;\\n    use crate::map_ops::{ast_key, ast_value, resolved_scalar_ast, MapOp, MAP_ID, SET_ID};\\n    if !op.reopens()\\n        || type_arguments\\n            .iter()\\n            .any(|ty| `Add`/`Set`.\\n    let expected = 2 + usize::from(matches!(op, MapOp::Add | MapOp::Set));\\n    args.len() == expected\\n        && collection(result)\\n        && collection(&args[0].ty)\\n        && args[1].ty == type_arguments[0]\\n        && (expected == 2 || args[2].ty == type_arguments[1])\\n}\\n\\npub(crate) fn is_same_owner_concat_hir_funded<E>(\\n    value: &ResolvedExpr,\\n    owner: {\\n        return Ok(false);\\n    }\\n    if args.len() > 1 {\\n        let needle = needle(owner, reserve)?;\\n        if args[1..].iter().any(|argument| mentions(argument, &needle)) {\\n }\\n    Ok(appends)\\n}\\n\\npub(crate) fn same_owner_concat_operands_funded<E>(\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\n    reserve: Reserve<'_, E>,\\n) -> Result<BTreeSet<ExpressionId>, FundedError<E>> else {\\\\n        return Ok(None);\\\\n    };\\\\n    Ok(Some(hir == plan))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nstruct BuiltComparison {\\\\n    automaton: Automaton,\\\\n    sink: usize,\\\\n    hir_root: usize,\\\\n    plan_root: usize,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Reconstruct both exact observation languages once, retaining every debit.\\\\n/// The exact strategy census borrows this same physical owner; it never\\\\n/// retries construction after choosing a representation.\\\\nfn build_comparison<'hir>(\\\\n    program: &'hir dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,\\\\n    function: &'hir ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    helpers: Option<&crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::ModuleIndex<'hir>>,\\\\n    continuations: Option<&mut continuation_storage::Storage<'hir>>,\\\\n) -> Result<BuiltComparison, Diagnostic> {\\\\n    // Both independent constructors debit skeleton helpers as well as ordinary\\\\n    // constructors. deferred attempt.\\\\n    #[cfg(test)]\\\\n    instrumentation::begin(function, budget);\\\\n    let skeleton_reserve = budget.skeleton_remaining;\\\\n    budget.skeleton_remaining = hir_skeleton_paths_with_index_storage(\\\\n            program,\\\\n            function,\\\\n            budget,\\\\n            helpers,\\\\n            continuations,\\\\n        );\\\\n  SkeletonTerminal::Success => success,\\\\n                SkeletonTerminal::Failure => failure,\\\\n                SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch => latch,\\\\n            };\\\\n     Ok(BuiltComparison {\\\\n            automaton,\\\\n            sink,\\\\n            hir_root,\\\\n            plan_root,\\\\n        })\\\\n    })();\\\\n    // Restore only the unused allowance. Successful debits from either\\\\n    // constructor remain spent, including an attempt ending in refusal.\\\\n    budget.merge_paths = false;\\\\n    budget.lent_skeleton = false;\\\\n    budget.remaining = std::mem::replace(&mut budget.skeleton_remaining, skeleton_reserve);\\\\n    #[cfg(test)]\\\\n    instrumentation::phase(\\\\n        function,\\\\n        budget,\\\\n        if result.is_ok() {\\\\n            \\\\\\\"constructed\\\\\\\"\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            \\\\\\\"constructor refusal\\\\\\\"\\\\n        },\\\\n        None,\\\\n    );\\\\n    result\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[path = \\\\\\\"factored/strategy.rs\\\\\\\"]\\\\npub(super) mod strategy;\\\\n\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\nstruct Automaton {\\\\n    nodes: Vec<Node>,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nenum Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the               let to = entry(edge.to);\\\\n                    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { .. } = &edge.condition {\\\\n                        let observation = edge_observation(function, budget, &edge.condition)?;\\\\n                        self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, to)?;\\\\n                    } else {\\\\n                        self.epsilon(function, budget, node, to)?;\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {\\\\n                    for edge in edges {\\\\n                        let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];\\\\n                        let observation = edge_observation(function, budget, &edge.condition)?;\\\\n                        self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, entry(edge.to))?;\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit) => {\\\\n                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit.0 as usize];\\\\n                    let target = match &exit.continuation {\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) => entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\n                            success\\\\n                        }\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { edge, .. } => {\\\\n                            let marker =\\\\n                                lexical_skeleton::plan_exit_observation(budget, function, exit.id)?\\\\n                                    .ok_or_else(|| {\\\\n                                        replay_error(\\\\n                                    function,\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\"factored lexical exit lacks an exact certificate marker\\\\\\\",\\\\n                                )\\\\n                                    })?;\\\\n                            // The marker itself is the labelled continuation edge.\\\\n                            // A lexical exit must never become an epsilon edge.\\\\n                            self.observation(\\\\n                                function,\\\\n                                budget,\\\\n                                node,\\\\n                                marker,\\\\n                                entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\n                            )?;\\\\n                            continue;\\\\n                        }\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopLatch { target } => {\\\\n                            let marker = match lexical_skeleton::plan_exit_observation(\\\\n                                budget, function, exit.id,\\\\n                            )? {\\\\n                                Some(marker) => marker,\\\\n                                None => SkeletonObservation::LoopLatch {\\\\n                                    target: skeleton_clone(\\\\n                                        budget,\\\\n                                        function,\\\\n                                        target,\\\\n                                        \\\\\\\"factored loop-latch target clone\\\\\\\",\\\\n                                    )?,\\\\n                                },\\\\n                            };\\\\n                            let target =\\\\n                                lexical_cert::latch_resume(plan, exit.id).map_or(latch, entry);\\\\n                            self.observation(function, budget, node, marker, target)?;\\\\n                            continue;\\\\n                        }\\\\n                    };\\\\n                    self.epsilon(function, budget, node, target)?;\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        Ok(entry(plan.entry))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one cleanup transition contributes, exactly as\\\\n/// the enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\nfn transition_observation(\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    transition: &CleanupTransition,\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition {\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize { at, destination }\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {\\\\n            at, destination, ..\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Initialize {\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, binding } => SkeletonObservation::ReserveRenewal {\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\n            binding: binding.clone(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Transfer {\\\\n            at,\\\\n            source,\\\\n            destination,\\\\n        }\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::Renew {\\\\n            at,\\\\n            source,\\\\n            destination,\\\\n        }\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::TransferVariant {\\\\n            at,\\\\n            source,\\\\n            destination,\\\\n            ..\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Transfer {\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, arguments } => SkeletonObservation::CallCommit {\\\\n            call: call.clone(),\\\\n            arguments: arguments\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .map(|argument| (argument.parameter_index, argument.source.clone()))\\\\n                .collect(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { source } => {\\\\n            SkeletonObservation::StageCopyResult(CopySource::new(function, budget, source.clone())?)\\\\n        }\\\\n        CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase { .. }\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. } => return Ok(None),\\\\n    }))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one edge condition contributes, exactly as the\\\\n/// enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\nfn edge_observation(\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    condition: &EdgeCondition,\\\\n) -> Result<SkeletonObservation, Diagnostic> {\\\\n    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\")?;\\\\n    }\\\\n    Ok(match condition {\\\\n        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, value) => SkeletonObservation::Boolean {\\\\n            expression: expression.clone(),\\\\n            value: *value,\\\\n        },\\\\n        EdgeCondition::VariantCase {\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\n            case,\\\\n            matches,\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::VariantCase {\\\\n            scrutinee: scrutinee.clone(),\\\\n            case: case.clone(),\\\\n            matches: *matches,\\\\n        },\\\\n        EdgeCondition::ArmSelected {\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\n            arm,\\\\n            selected,\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::ArmSelected {\\\\n            scrutinee: scrutinee.clone(),\\\\n            arm: *arm,\\\\n            selected: *selected,\\\\n        },\\\\n        EdgeCondition::StatusZero(source) => SkeletonObservation::Status {\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\n            success: true,\\\\n        },\\\\n        EdgeCondition::StatusNonzero(source) => SkeletonObservation::Status {\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\n            success: false,\\\\n        },\\\\n        EdgeCondition::Always => {\\\\n            return Err(replay_error(\\\\n                function,\\\\n                \\\\\\\"branch skeleton contains an unconditional edge\\\\\\\",\\\\n            ));\\\\n        }\\\\n    })\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// A weighted set of automaton nodes: each node with the number of distinct\\\\n/// automaton paths that reach Equal snapshots already have precisely the required early\\\\n        // error publication; avoid reallocating an unchanged whole map.\\\\n        if self.enabled && self.published != *scope {\\\\n            self.published.retain(|key, _| scope.contains_key(key));\\\\n            for (key, binding) in scope {\\\\n                if let Some(published) = self.published.get_mut(key) {\\\\n                    if published != binding {\\\\n                        published.clone_from(binding);\\\\n                    }\\\\n                } else {\\\\n                    self.published.insert(key.clone(), binding.clone());\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nimpl Drop for ValidationScopePublication<'_> {\\\\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\\\\n        std::mem::swap(self.target, &mut self.published);\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Verify and resolve a parsed program into deterministic HIR.\\\\n///\\\\n/// Verification errors are returned unchanged. continuation_receiver;\\\\n\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod moderate_tests;\\\\n\\\",\\n        \\\"before\\\": \\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\n//! product:\\\\n//!\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset continuation_receiver;\\\\n\\\",\\n        \\\"new\\\": \\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\n//! product:\\\\n//!\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod borrowed_canonical;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod canonical_before;\\\\nmod canonical_shared;\\\\npub(super) mod copy_regions;\\\\nmod dag_memo;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod instrumentation;\\\\nmod storage;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nuse canonical_before::Receiver as Canonicalizer;\\\\nuse storage::{memo_insert, push_end, push_frame, reserve_transition_observation};\\\\n\\\\n/// Representation crossover, independent of the admitted path/work limits.\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 256;\\\\n// Preserve the original broad factored domain and every original small-function\\\\n// enumeration cross-check. &function.cleanup_plan;\\\\n    cfg_paths > ENUMERATION_CROSS_CHECK_THRESHOLD\\\\n        || semantic_paths > ENUMERATION_CROSS_CHECK_THRESHOLD\\\\n        || (plan.slots.is_empty()\\\\n            && Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//! moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Seq(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Seq(_, items) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod 4_096;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]\\\\\\\\nenum Label {\\\\\\\\n    Observation(Rc<SkeletonObservation>),\\\\\\\\n {\\\\\\\\n    if cfg_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD && semantic_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    match OwnershipMode,\\\\\\\\n    availability: Availability,\\\\\\\\n    moved_places: BTreeMap<Vec<PlaceProjection>, Availability>,\\\\\\\\n    definitely_partial: BTreeSet<Vec<PlaceProjection>>,\\\\\\\\n    /// Exact shared loans currently protecting this storage root.\\\\\\\\n    active_loans: BTreeSet<LoanId>,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Restores the most recently published ownership scope on every early\\\\\\\\n/// validation return. Iterative continuations update the publication boundary\\\\\\\\n/// before entering a direct child; isolated Block/branch/arm children leave it\\\\\\\\n/// at their outer baseline.\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nstruct ValidationScopePublication<'a> {\\\\\\\\n    target: &'a mut BTreeMap<ValueId, ValidationBinding>,\\\\\\\\n    published: BTreeMap<ValueId, ValidationBinding>,\\\\\\\\n    enabled: bool,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nimpl ValidationScopePublication<'_> {\\\\\\\\n    fn publish(&mut self, scope: &BTreeMap<ValueId, ValidationBinding>) {\\\\\\\\n        // Full equality includes nested move/partial/loan state and exact\\\\\\\\n        // types. Equal snapshots already have precisely the required early\\\\\\\\n        // error publication; avoid reallocating an unchanged whole map.\\\\\\\\n        if self.enabled && self.published != *scope {\\\\\\\\n            self.published.retain(|key, _| scope.contains_key(key));\\\\\\\\n            for (key, binding) in scope {\\\\\\\\n                if let Some(published) = self.published.get_mut(key) {\\\\\\\\n                    if published != binding {\\\\\\\\n                        published.clone_from(binding);\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                } else {\\\\\\\\n                    self.published.insert(key.clone(), binding.clone());\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nimpl Drop for ValidationScopePublication<'_> {\\\\\\\\n    fn drop(&mut self) {\\\\\\\\n        std::mem::swap(self.target, &mut self.published);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Verify and resolve a parsed program into deterministic HIR.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// Verification errors are returned unchanged. This makes the HIR boundary\\\\\\\\n/// fail closed: no backend can accidentally resolve and execute an invalid AST.\\\\\\\\npub fn resolve(program: &Program) -> Result<ResolvedProgram, Vec<Diagnostic>> {\\\\\\\\n    #[cfg(feature = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"unstable-workflow-profiling\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")]\\\\\\\\n    let _workflow_span = crate::workflow_profile::span(crate::workflow_profile::Stage::Resolve);\\\\\\\\n    let Analysis {\\\\\\\\n        diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n        resolved,\\\\\\\\n    } = analyze(program);\\\\\\\\n    resolved.ok_or(diagnostics)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Private checked-module seam for exact monomorphic function reuse.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// Source verification and declaration-index construction always run first.\\\\\\\\n/// A prior function is eligible only when the complete non-body environment,\\\\\\\\n/// every function signature, and that function's full AST are exactly equal.\\\\\\\\n/// The resolver still rebuilds and validates the complete `ResolvedProgram`.\\\\\\\\n/// `private` only changes how source diagnostics name `program`'s private\\\\\\\\n/// layout copies.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// Explicit legacy compatibility: ordinary workspace resolution uses the\\\\\\\\n/// identity-paid `identity_resolution::resolve_checked` sibling instead.\\\\\\\\n#[cfg_attr(\\\\\\\\n    not(test),\\\\\\\\n    allow(\\\\\\\\n        dead_code,\\\\\\\\n        reason = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"legacy unpaid route retained as the saved oracle for the paid sibling\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n    )\\\\\\\\n)]\\\\\\\\npub(crate) fn resolve_with_function_reuse<'p>(\\\\\\\\n    program: &'p Program,\\\\\\\\n    previous_program: Option<&Program>,\\\\\\\\n    previous_resolved: Option<&ResolvedProgram>,\\\\\\\\n    previous_costs: Option<&BTreeMap<String, usize>>,\\\\\\\\n    private: Option<source_verify::private_names::PrivateNames<'p>>,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<(ResolvedProgram, FunctionResolutionWork), Vec<Diagnostic>> {\\\\\\\\n    #[cfg(feature = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"unstable-workflow-profiling\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")]\\\\\\\\n    let _workflow_span = crate::workflow_profile::span(crate::workflow_profile::Stage::Resolve);\\\\\\\\n    let diagnostics = source_verify::verify_presenting(program, private);\\\\\\\\n    if diagnostics\\\\\\\\n        .iter()\\\\\\\\n        .any(|diagnostic| diagnostic.severity.is_error())\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        return Err(diagnostics);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    let reuse = previous_program\\\\\\\\n        .zip(previous_resolved)\\\\\\\\n        .zip(previous_costs)\\\\\\\\n        .filter(|((previous, _), _)| function_reuse_environment_is_exact(program, previous))\\\\\\\\n        .map(|((previous, resolved), costs)| FunctionReuse {\\\\\\\\n            current: program,\\\\\\\\n            program: previous,\\\\\\\\n            resolved,\\\\\\\\n            costs,\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n    resolve_verified(program, reuse).map_err(|error| vec![error])\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Full ordinary verification of the private borrowed presentation. Recursive\\\\\\\\n/// record-invariant desugaring owns its AST only at the transformation boundary.\\\\\\\\n/// Explicit legacy compatibility; the paid sibling is\\\\\\\\n/// `identity_resolution::resolve_source`.\\\\\\\\n#[cfg_attr(\\\\\\\\n    not(test),\\\\\\\\n    allow(\\\\\\\\n        dead_code,\\\\\\\\n        reason = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"legacy unpaid route retained as the saved oracle for the paid sibling\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n    )\\\\\\\\n)]\\\\\\\\npub(crate) fn resolve_source<'p>(\\\\\\\\n    program: &'p dyn ProgramSource,\\\\\\\\n    private: Option<source_verify::private_names::PrivateNames<'p>>,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<(ResolvedProgram, FunctionResolutionWork), Vec<Diagnostic>> {\\\\\\\\n    let diagnostics = source_verify::verify_presenting(program, private);\\\\\\\\n    if diagnostics\\\\\\\\n        .iter()\\\\\\\\n        .any(|diagnostic| diagnostic.severity.is_error())\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        return Err(diagnostics);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    let clause_program = record_invariants::source::clause_program(program);\\\\\\\\n    let inventory: &dyn ProgramSource = clause_program.as_ref().map_or(program, |owned| owned);\\\\\\\\n    let resolved = resolve_source_pass(inventory)?;\\\\\\\\n    let Some(desugared) = record_invariants::source::desugar(program, &resolved.0) else {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(resolved);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    resolve_source_pass(&desugared)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn resolve_source_pass(\\\\\\\\n    program: &dyn ProgramSource,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<(ResolvedProgram, FunctionResolutionWork), Vec<Diagnostic>> {\\\\\\\\n    (Resolver {\\\\\\\\n        program,\\\\\\\\n        byte_helpers: crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::SourceIndex::new(program),\\\\\\\\n        declarations: DeclarationIndex::from_verified_with_prelude(\\\\\\\\n            program,\\\\\\\\n            crate::prelude::declarations_for_program(program),\\\\\\\\n        )\\\\\\\\n        .map_err(|error| vec![error])?,\\\\\\\\n        reuse: None,\\\\\\\\n        function_work: FunctionResolutionWork::default(),\\\\\\\\n        fused_producer: None,\\\\\\\\n        partition_profile: false,\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n    .resolve()\\\\\\\\n    .map_err(|error| vec![error])\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Resolve a verified program. Record Invariants v1: when a record declares\\\\\\\\n/// invariants, the resolution of the original supplies the record type of\\\\\\\\n/// every production site, and the program is resolved once more after\\\\\\\\n/// [`record_invariants::desugar`] routes those sites through their checks.\\\\\\\\nfn resolve_verified(\\\\\\\\n    program: &Program,\\\\\\\\n    reuse: Option<FunctionReuse<'_>>,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<(ResolvedProgram, FunctionResolutionWork), Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    let clause_program = record_invariants::clause_program(program);\\\\\\\\n    let inventory_program = clause_program.as_ref().unwrap_or(program);\\\\\\\\n    let resolved = (Resolver {\\\\\\\\n        program: inventory_program,\\\\\\\\n        byte_helpers: crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::SourceIndex::new(inventory_program),\\\\\\\\n        declarations: DeclarationIndex::from_verified(inventory_program)?,\\\\\\\\n        reuse: if clause_program.is_some() {\\\\\\\\n            None\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            reuse\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        function_work: FunctionResolutionWork::default(),\\\\\\\\n        fused_producer: None,\\\\\\\\n        partition_profile: false,\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n    .resolve()?;\\\\\\\\n    let Some(desugared) = record_invariants::desugar(program, &resolved.0) else {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(resolved);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    (Resolver {\\\\\\\\n        program: &desugared,\\\\\\\\n        byte_helpers: crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::SourceIndex::new(&desugared),\\\\\\\\n        declarations: DeclarationIndex::from_verified(&desugared)?,\\\\\\\\n        reuse: None,\\\\\\\\n        function_work: FunctionResolutionWork::default(),\\\\\\\\n        fused_producer: None,\\\\\\\\n        partition_profile: false,\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n    .resolve()\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\\\\\npub(crate) struct FunctionResolutionWork {\\\\\\\\n    costs: BTreeMap<String, usize>,\\\\\\\\n    reused: usize,\\\\\\\\n    static_text: bool,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl FunctionResolutionWork {\\\\\\\\n    pub(crate) fn static_text(&self) -> bool {\\\\\\\\n        self.static_text\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    pub(crate) fn costs(self) -> BTreeMap<String, usize> {\\\\\\\\n        self.costs\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    pub(crate) fn reused(&self) -> usize {\\\\\\\\n        self.reused\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The source diagnostics and optional resolved meaning from one analysis.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// Warnings do not prevent resolution. Any source error fails closed before the\\\\\\\\n/// resolver runs, so invalid source cannot leak internal HIR diagnostics.\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\\\\\\\\npub struct Analysis {\\\\\\\\n    pub diagnostics: Vec<Diagnostic>,\\\\\\\\n    pub resolved: Option<ResolvedProgram>,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Verify source once and resolve it when only warnings remain.\\\\\\\\npub fn analyze(program: &Program) -> Analysis {\\\\\\\\n    let diagnostics = source_verify::verify(program);\\\\\\\\n    if diagnostics\\\\\\\\n        .iter()\\\\\\\\n        .any(|diagnostic| diagnostic.severity.is_error())\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n            resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // The ordinary caller captures only its existing invocation ledger. A\\\\\\\\n    // setup-short compatibility call retains the original owned diagnostic\\\\\\\\n    // route; initial report setup is not claimed funded by this activation.\\\\\\\\n    if ordinary_identity::can_acquire() {\\\\\\\\n        match ordinary_identity::try_resolve_verified_compatible(program) {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Ok((resolved, _))) => {\\\\\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n                    resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n                };\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Err(diagnostics)) => {\\\\\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n                    resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n                };\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            Err(_) => {} // Legacy setup-only diagnostic compatibility below.\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    match resolve_verified(program, None) {\\\\\\\\n        Ok((resolved, _)) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n            resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        Err(diagnostic) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            // Preserve `resolve`'s established invariant-failure behavior: an\\\\\\\\n            // internal HIR diagnostic replaces otherwise non-fatal warnings.\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics: vec![diagnostic],\\\\\\\\n            resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn hir_error(message: impl Into<String>) -> Diagnostic {\\\\\\\\n    Diagnostic::io(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"SPX-H006\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", message)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn hir_error_static(message: &'static str) -> Diagnostic {\\\\\\\\n    Diagnostic::io_static(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"SPX-H006\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", message)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nstruct FunctionReuse<'a> {\\\\\\\\n    // The environment proof belongs to this exact current source receiver.\\\\\\\\n    current: &'a dyn ProgramSource,\\\\\\\\n    program: &'a dyn ProgramSource,\\\\\\\\n    resolved: &'a ResolvedProgram,\\\\\\\\n    costs: &'a BTreeMap<String, usize>,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nstruct Resolver<'a> {\\\\\\\\n    program: &'a dyn ProgramSource,\\\\\\\\n    byte_helpers: crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::SourceIndex<'a>,\\\\\\\\n bool,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn function_reuse_environment_is_exact(current: &dyn ProgramSource, previous: &Program) -> bool {\\\\\\\\n    // Generic declarations participate in the same complete ordered signature\\\\\\\\n    // proof, including scoped type parameters, contracts and source spans.\\\\\\\\n    // Only monomorphic HIR is cloned. Current templates and the entire instance\\\\\\\\n    // closure are rebuilt below from this exact source, never from reuse.resolved.\\\\\\\\n    current.path() == previous.path\\\\\\\\n        && current.module() == previous.module\\\\\\\\n        && current.module_uses() == previous.module_uses\\\\\\\\n        && current.permits() == previous.permits\\\\\\\\n        && current.types().iter().eq(&previous.types)\\\\\\\\n        && current.interfaces() == previous.interfaces\\\\\\\\n        && current.protocols() == previous.protocols\\\\\\\\n        && current.implementations() == previous.implementations\\\\\\\\n        && current.functions().len() == previous.functions.len()\\\\\\\\n        && current\\\\\\\\n            .functions()\\\\\\\\n            .iter()\\\\\\\\n            .zip(&previous.functions)\\\\\\\\n            .all(|(current, previous)| function_signature_is_exact(current, previous))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn function_signature_is_exact(\\\\\\\\n    current: &crate::ast::Function,\\\\\\\\n    previous: &crate::ast::Function,\\\\\\\\n) -> bool {\\\\\\\\n    current.stable_id == previous.stable_id\\\\\\\\n        && current.explicit_id == previous.explicit_id\\\\\\\\n        && current.name == previous.name\\\\\\\\n        && current.name_span == previous.name_span\\\\\\\\n        && current.type_parameters == previous.type_parameters\\\\\\\\n        && current.params == previous.params\\\\\\\\n        && current.return_type == previous.return_type\\\\\\\\n        && current.effects == previous.effects\\\\\\\\n        && current.yields == previous.yields\\\\\\\\n        && current.follows == previous.follows\\\\\\\\n        && current.requires == previous.requires\\\\\\\\n        && current.ensures == previous.ensures\\\\\\\\n        && current.span == previous.span\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Source byte-helper admission reads current transitive bodies and keeps a\\\\\\\\n/// phase-owned proof memo/failure. Those call-bearing functions resolve afresh;\\\\\\\\n/// cloning their HIR would skip the source diagnostics and proof side effects.\\\\\\\\n/// Ordinary signature-bound calls, including generic calls, remain reusable.\\\\\\\\nfn function_requires_current_byte_helper_resolution(\\\\\\\\n    source: &dyn ProgramSource,\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n) -> bool {\\\\\\\\n    let mut requires = false;\\\\\\\\n    for expression in function\\\\\\\\n        .requires\\\\\\\\n        .iter()\\\\\\\\n        .chain(std::iter::once(&function.body))\\\\\\\\n        .chain(&function.ensures)\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        inspection::visit_resolved_calls(expression, &mut |callee, _, _| {\\\\\\\\n            requires |= source.functions().iter().any(|target| {\\\\\\\\n                target.stable_id == callee.as_str()\\\\\\\\n                    && crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::SourceIndex::may_require_body_proof(target)\\\\\\\\n            });\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    requires\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod function_reuse_environment_tests {\\\\\\\\n    use super::*;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The source diagnostics and optional resolved meaning from one analysis.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// Warnings do not prevent resolution. Any source error fails closed before the\\\\\\\\n/// resolver runs, so invalid source cannot leak internal HIR diagnostics.\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\\\\\\\\npub struct Analysis {\\\\\\\\n    pub diagnostics: Vec<Diagnostic>,\\\\\\\\n    pub resolved: Option<ResolvedProgram>,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Verify source once and resolve it when only warnings remain.\\\\\\\\npub fn analyze(program: &Program) -> Analysis {\\\\\\\\n    let diagnostics = source_verify::verify(program);\\\\\\\\n    if diagnostics\\\\\\\\n        .iter()\\\\\\\\n        .any(|diagnostic| diagnostic.severity.is_error())\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n            resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // The ordinary caller captures only its existing invocation ledger. A\\\\\\\\n    // setup-short compatibility call retains the original owned diagnostic\\\\\\\\n    // route; initial report setup is not claimed funded by this activation.\\\\\\\\n    if ordinary_identity::can_acquire() {\\\\\\\\n        match ordinary_identity::try_resolve_verified_compatible(program) {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Ok((resolved, _))) => {\\\\\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n                    resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n                };\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Err(diagnostics)) => {\\\\\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n                    resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n                };\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            Err(_) => {} // Legacy setup-only diagnostic compatibility below.\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    match resolve_verified(program, None) {\\\\\\\\n        Ok((resolved, _)) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n            resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        Err(diagnostic) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            // Preserve `resolve`'s established invariant-failure behavior: an\\\\\\\\n            // internal HIR diagnostic replaces otherwise non-fatal warnings.\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics: vec![diagnostic],\\\\\\\\n            resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn hir_error(message: impl Into<String>) -> Diagnostic {\\\\\\\\n Diagnostic::io_static(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"SPX-H006\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", message)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nstruct FunctionReuse<'a> {\\\\\\\\n    // The environment proof belongs to this exact current source Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//! Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod borrowed_canonical;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod canonical_before;\\\\\\\\nmod canonical_shared;\\\\\\\\npub(super) mod copy_regions;\\\\\\\\nmod dag_memo;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod instrumentation;\\\\\\\\nmod storage;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nuse canonical_before::Receiver as Canonicalizer;\\\\\\\\nuse storage::{memo_insert, push_end, push_frame, reserve_transition_observation};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Representation crossover, independent of the admitted path/work limits.\\\\\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 256;\\\\\\\\n// Preserve the original broad factored domain and every original small-function\\\\\\\\n// enumeration cross-check.   CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n                    let target = match &exit.continuation {\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) => entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\\\\\n                            success\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { edge, .. } => {\\\\\\\\n                            let marker =\\\\\\\\n                                lexical_skeleton::plan_exit_observation(budget, function, exit.id)?\\\\\\\\n                                    .ok_or_else(|| {\\\\\\\\n edge.\\\\\\\\n                            // A lexical exit must never become an epsilon edge.\\\\\\\\n                            self.observation(\\\\\\\\n edge_observation(\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    condition: &EdgeCondition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<SkeletonObservation, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod reserve_transition_observation};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Path count above which the factored comparison replaces enumeration.\\\\\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 4_096;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]\\\\\\\\nenum Label {\\\\\\\\n    Observation(Rc<SkeletonObservation>),\\\\\\\\n    End(SkeletonTerminal),\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\\\\\nstruct Node {\\\\\\\\n    moves: Vec<(Label, usize)>,\\\\\\\\n    epsilon: Vec<usize>,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// {\\\\\\\\n    if cfg_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD && semantic_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    match structural_control::validate_ordinary_cfg(function, budget) {\\\\\\\\n        Ok(()) => Ok(true),\\\\\\\\n        Err(error) if budget.refusal_spent || crate::bounded_output::active_refused() => Err(error),\\\\\\\\n        Err(_) => Ok(false),\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n/// `true` when this function's typed-control skeleton is compared factored.\\\\\\\\n/// semantic_paths: usize,\\\\\\\\n) -> bool {\\\\\\\\n    (cfg_paths > FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD || semantic_paths > FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD)\\\\\\\\n        && else {\\\\\\\\n            return Ok(None);\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(Some(hir == plan));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let mut canonical = canonical_shared::Canonicalizer::new(&automaton, sink);\\\\\\\\n    budget.reserve_array::<(usize, u64)>(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR weighted root\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n    let Some(hir) = canonical.id(function, vec![(hir_root, 1)], budget)? else {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(None);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    budget.reserve_array::<(usize, u64)>(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored plan weighted root\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n    let Some(plan) = canonical.id(function, vec![(plan_root, 1)], budget)? else {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(None);\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Some(hir == plan))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nstruct BuiltComparison {\\\\\\\\n    automaton: Automaton,\\\\\\\\n    sink: usize,\\\\\\\\n    hir_root: usize,\\\\\\\\n    plan_root: usize,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Reconstruct both exact observation languages once, retaining every debit.\\\\\\\\n/// The exact strategy census borrows this same physical owner; it never\\\\\\\\n/// retries construction after choosing a representation.\\\\\\\\nfn build_comparison<'hir>(\\\\\\\\n    program: &'hir dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,\\\\\\\\n    function: &'hir ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    helpers: Option<&crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::ModuleIndex<'hir>>,\\\\\\\\n    continuations: Option<&mut continuation_storage::Storage<'hir>>,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<BuiltComparison, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    // Both independent constructors debit skeleton helpers as well as ordinary\\\\\\\\n    // constructors. Keep one active allowance through the HIR walk AND plan\\\\\\\\n    // automaton construction; the held program reservation belongs to other\\\\\\\\n    // enumerated functions and cannot pay for this deferred attempt.\\\\\\\\n    #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n    instrumentation::begin(function, budget);\\\\\\\\n    let skeleton_reserve = budget.skeleton_remaining;\\\\\\\\n    budget.skeleton_remaining = std::mem::take(&mut budget.remaining);\\\\\\\\n    budget.lent_skeleton = true;\\\\\\\\n    let result = (|| {\\\\\\\\n        budget.merge_paths = true;\\\\\\\\n        let hir_paths = hir_skeleton_paths_with_index_storage(\\\\\\\\n            program,\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            budget,\\\\\\\\n            helpers,\\\\\\\\n            continuations,\\\\\\\\n        );\\\\\\\\n        budget.merge_paths = false;\\\\\\\\n        #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n        instrumentation::phase(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            budget,\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"HIR skeleton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            hir_paths.as_ref().map(|paths| paths.as_slice()).ok(),\\\\\\\\n        );\\\\\\\\n        let hir_paths = hir_paths?;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        let mut automaton = Automaton::default();\\\\\\\\n        let sink = automaton.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        let success = automaton.end(function, budget, sink, SkeletonTerminal::Success)?;\\\\\\\\n        let failure = automaton.end(function, budget, sink, SkeletonTerminal::Failure)?;\\\\\\\\n        let latch = automaton.end(function, budget, sink, SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch)?;\\\\\\\\n        let hir_root = automaton.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut memo = dag_memo::new(program, function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        for path in &hir_paths {\\\\\\\\n            let end = automaton.add_observations(\\\\\\\\n                function,\\\\\\\\n                &path.observations,\\\\\\\\n                hir_root,\\\\\\\\n                &mut memo,\\\\\\\\n                budget,\\\\\\\\n            )?;\\\\\\\\n            let terminal = match path.terminal {\\\\\\\\n                SkeletonTerminal::Success => success,\\\\\\\\n                SkeletonTerminal::Failure => failure,\\\\\\\\n                SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch => latch,\\\\\\\\n            };\\\\\\\\n            automaton.epsilon(function, budget, end, terminal)?;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n        instrumentation::phase(function, budget, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", None);\\\\\\\\n        let plan_root = automaton.add_plan(function, success, failure, latch, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n        instrumentation::phase(function, budget, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"plan automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", None);\\\\\\\\n        Ok(BuiltComparison {\\\\\\\\n            automaton,\\\\\\\\n            sink,\\\\\\\\n            hir_root,\\\\\\\\n            plan_root,\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n    })();\\\\\\\\n    // Restore only the unused allowance. Successful debits from either\\\\\\\\n    // constructor remain spent, including an attempt ending in refusal.\\\\\\\\n    budget.merge_paths = false;\\\\\\\\n    budget.lent_skeleton = false;\\\\\\\\n    budget.remaining = std::mem::replace(&mut budget.skeleton_remaining, skeleton_reserve);\\\\\\\\n    #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n    instrumentation::phase(\\\\\\\\n        function,\\\\\\\\n        budget,\\\\\\\\n        if result.is_ok() {\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"constructed\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"constructor refusal\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    result\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[path = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored/strategy.rs\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"]\\\\\\\\npub(super) mod strategy;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\\\\\nstruct Automaton {\\\\\\\\n    nodes: &CleanupTransition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition {\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize { at, destination }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {\\\\\\\\n            at, destination, ..\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Initialize {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, destination,\\\\\\\\n            ..\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Transfer {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, arguments } => SkeletonObservation::CallCommit {\\\\\\\\n            call: }))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one edge condition contributes, exactly as the\\\\\\\\n/// enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\\\\\nfn edge_observation(\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    condition: &EdgeCondition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<SkeletonObservation, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    Ok(match condition {\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, value) => SkeletonObservation::Boolean {\\\\\\\\n            expression: expression.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            value: *value,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::VariantCase {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\\\\\n            case,\\\\\\\\n            matches,\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::VariantCase {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee: scrutinee.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            case: case.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            matches: *matches,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::ArmSelected {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\\\\\n            arm,\\\\\\\\n            selected,\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::ArmSelected {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee: scrutinee.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            arm: *arm,\\\\\\\\n            selected: *selected,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::StatusZero(source) => SkeletonObservation::Status {\\\\\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            success: false,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::Always => {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(replay_error(\\\\\\\\n                function,\\\\\\\\n                \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"branch skeleton contains an unconditional edge\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            ));\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// A weighted set of automaton nodes: each node with the number of distinct\\\\\\\\n/// automaton paths that reach it on one observation Weighted)>),\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Test builds compare the factored verdict with the enumerating one on every\\\\\\\\n/// function small enough to enumerate.\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nfn cross_check(program: &dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext, function: &ResolvedFunction) {\\\\\\\\n    let saved = SKELETON_MATERIALIZATIONS.with(Cell::get);\\\\\\\\n    let mut enumerating = ReplayBudget::with_skeleton_limit(MAX_REPLAY_WORK_UNITS);\\\\\\\\n    let enumerated = hir_skeleton_paths(program, function, &mut enumerating).and_then(|mut hir| {\\\\\\\\n        let mut plan =            verdict.map_err(|error| error.message)\\\\\\\\n        );\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    SKELETON_MATERIALIZATIONS.with(|count| count.set(saved));\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n// Pending oracle moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod  }\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            items.len().saturating_add(1),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        self.chain(function, budget, end, items)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_dag(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        root: &Rc<ObservationDag>,\\\\\\\\n        start: usize,\\\\\\\\n        memo: &mut dag_memo::Memo,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let key = dag_memo::key;\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_array::<BuildFrame<'_>>(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored DAG initial frame\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut frames =   BuildFrame::Visit(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let retained =    if let Some(end) = retained {\\\\\\\\n                        push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, end)?;\\\\\\\\n                        continue;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                    match &dag.kind {\\\\\\\\n                        ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, _) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(function, budget, &mut frames, BuildFrame::Seq(dag,                           budget,\\\\\\\\n                                    &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                    BuildFrame::Visit(prefix, start),\\\\\\\\n                                )?,\\\\\\\\n                                None => push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, start)?,\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ObservationDagKind::Cat(_) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, start)?;\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                    function,\\\\\\\\n                                    budget,\\\\\\\\n                                    &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                    BuildFrame::Visit(member, start),\\\\\\\\n                                )?;\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Seq(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Seq(_, items) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence frame holds a sequence node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let prefix_end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence prefix end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, items.len(), \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let end = self.chain(function, budget, prefix_end, items)?;\\\\\\\\n                    memo_insert(function, budget, memo, key(dag, start), end)?;\\\\\\\\n                    push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, end)?;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, index) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Cat(parts) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation frame holds a concatenation node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation part end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    match parts.get(index) {\\\\\\\\n                        Some(part) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, index + 1),\\\\\\\\n                            )?;\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                BuildFrame::Visit(part, end),\\\\\\\\n                            )?;\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        None => {\\\\\\\\n                            memo_insert(function, budget, memo, key(dag, start), end)?;\\\\\\\\n                            push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, end)?;\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Alt(dag, start, count) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let join = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    for _ in join)?;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored DAG build produced an end\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"))\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_plan(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        success: usize,\\\\\\\\n        failure: usize,\\\\\\\\n        latch: usize,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            plan_structure_units(plan),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored cleanup-plan automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_array::<usize>(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            plan.blocks.len(),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored plan block entries\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(plan.blocks.len());\\\\\\\\n        for _ in &plan.blocks {\\\\\\\\n            entries.push(self.node(function, budget)?);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        let entry = |block: BlockId| entries[block.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n        for (index, block) in plan.blocks.iter().enumerate() {\\\\\\\\n            let mut node = entries[index];\\\\\\\\n            for transition in &block.transitions {\\\\\\\\n                if let Some(observation) = transition_observation(function, budget, transition)? {\\\\\\\\n                    let next = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, next)?;\\\\\\\\n                    node = next;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            match &block.terminator {\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Goto(edge) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n                    let to = entry(edge.to);\\\\\\\\n                    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { .. } = &edge.condition {\\\\\\\\n                        let observation =               self.epsilon(function, budget, node, to)?;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {\\\\\\\\n &edge.condition)?;\\\\\\\\n                        self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, entry(edge.to))?;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n                    let target = match &exit.continuation {\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) => entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\\\\\n                            success\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { edge, .. } => {\\\\\\\\n                            let marker =\\\\\\\\n }\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(entry(plan.entry))\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one cleanup transition contributes, exactly as\\\\\\\\n/// the enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\\\\\nfn transition_observation(\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    transition: &CleanupTransition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition {\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize { at, destination }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {\\\\\\\\n            at, destination, ..\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Initialize {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, continuation_receiver;\\\\n\\\",\\n        \\\"new\\\": \\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\n//! product:\\\\n//!\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod borrowed_canonical;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod canonical_before;\\\\nmod canonical_shared;\\\\npub(super) mod copy_regions;\\\\nmod dag_memo;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod instrumentation;\\\\nmod storage;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nuse canonical_before::Receiver as Canonicalizer;\\\\nuse storage::{memo_insert, push_end, push_frame, reserve_transition_observation};\\\\n\\\\n/// Representation crossover, independent of the admitted path/work limits.\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 256;\\\\n// Preserve the original broad factored domain and every original small-function\\\\n// enumeration cross-check. Earlier selection is only a representation choice.\\\\nconst ENUMERATION_CROSS_CHECK_THRESHOLD: usize = 4_096;\\\\n\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]\\\\nenum Label {\\\\n    Observation(Rc<SkeletonObservation>),\\\\n    End(SkeletonTerminal),\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\nstruct Node {\\\\n    moves: Vec<(Label, usize)>,\\\\n    epsilon: Vec<usize>,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Borrowed headers select a representation; structural and complete weighted\\\\n// language verification retain all acceptance authority. Resource-bearing\\\\n// functions keep the original window because their states need not coalesce.\\\\nfn representation_candidate(\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    cfg_paths: usize,\\\\n    semantic_paths: usize,\\\\n) -> bool {\\\\n    if cfg_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD && semantic_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD {\\\\n        return false;\\\\n    }\\\\n    let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;\\\\n    cfg_paths > ENUMERATION_CROSS_CHECK_THRESHOLD\\\\n        || semantic_paths > ENUMERATION_CROSS_CHECK_THRESHOLD\\\\n        || (plan.slots.is_empty()\\\\n            && destination: destination.clone(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, arguments } => SkeletonObservation::CallCommit {\\\\n            call: call.clone(),\\\\n            arguments: arguments\\\\n                .iter()\\\\n                .map(|argument| (argument.parameter_index, argument.source.clone()))\\\\n                .collect(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { source } => {\\\\n            SkeletonObservation::StageCopyResult(CopySource::new(function, budget, source.clone())?)\\\\n        }\\\\n        CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase { .. }\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. } => return Ok(None),\\\\n    }))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one edge condition     } => SkeletonObservation::VariantCase {\\\\n            scrutinee: scrutinee.clone(),\\\\n            case: case.clone(),\\\\n            matches: *matches,\\\\n        },\\\\n        EdgeCondition::ArmSelected {\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\n            arm,\\\\n            selected,\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::ArmSelected {\\\\n            scrutinee: Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//!
