deferred attempt.\\\\\\\\n    #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n    instrumentation::begin(function, budget);\\\\\\\\n    let skeleton_reserve = budget.skeleton_remaining;\\\\\\\\n    budget.skeleton_remaining = std::mem::take(&mut budget.remaining);\\\\\\\\n    budget.lent_skeleton = true;\\\\\\\\n    let result = (|| {\\\\\\\\n        budget.merge_paths = true;\\\\\\\\n        let hir_paths =      );\\\\\\\\n        budget.merge_paths = false;\\\\\\\\n        #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n        instrumentation::phase(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            budget,\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"HIR skeleton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            hir_paths.as_ref().map(|paths| paths.as_slice()).ok(),\\\\\\\\n        );\\\\\\\\n        let hir_paths = sink, SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch)?;\\\\\\\\n        let hir_root = automaton.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut memo = dag_memo::new(program, function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        for \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"constructor refusal\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    result\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[path = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored/strategy.rs\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"]\\\\\\\\npub(super) mod strategy;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\\\\\nstruct Automaton {\\\\\\\\n    nodes:    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    Ok(match condition {\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, value) => SkeletonObservation::Boolean {\\\\\\\\n            expression: expression.clone(),\\\\\\\\n }\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// A weighted set of automaton nodes: each node with the number of distinct\\\\\\\\n/// automaton paths that reach it on one observation moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod sink)?;\\\\\\\\n        Ok(node)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn chain(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n        mut end: usize,\\\\\\\\n        items: &[Rc<SkeletonObservation>],\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        for item in items {\\\\\\\\n            let next = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n            self.movement(\\\\\\\\n                function,\\\\\\\\n                budget,\\\\\\\\n                end,\\\\\\\\n                Label::Observation(item.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                next,\\\\\\\\n            )?;\\\\\\\\n            end = next;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(end)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Build `observations` forward from `start` and return its end node.\\\\\\\\n    /// A shared DAG node is built once per start node, so a merged prefix\\\\\\\\n    /// that many later paths extend exists once in the automaton.\\\\\\\\n    fn add_observations(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        observations: &Observations,\\\\\\\\n        start: usize,\\\\\\\\n        memo: &mut dag_memo::Memo,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let (prefix, items) = observations.parts();\\\\\\\\n        let mut end = start;\\\\\\\\n        if let Some(prefix) = prefix {\\\\\\\\n            end = self.add_dag(function, prefix, start, memo, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            items.len().saturating_add(1),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        self.chain(function, budget, end, items)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_dag(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        root: &Rc<ObservationDag>,\\\\\\\\n        start: usize,\\\\\\\\n        memo: &mut dag_memo::Memo,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let key = dag_memo::key;\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_array::<BuildFrame<'_>>(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored DAG initial frame\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut frames = vec![BuildFrame::Visit(root, start)];\\\\\\\\n        let mut ends = Vec::<usize>::new();\\\\\\\\n        while let Some(frame) = frames.pop() {\\\\\\\\n            match frame {\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Visit(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let retained = dag_memo::get(function, memo, &key(dag, start), budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n                    instrumentation::visit(dag, retained.is_some());\\\\\\\\n          match &dag.kind {\\\\\\\\n                        ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, _) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(function, budget, &mut frames, BuildFrame::Seq(dag, start))?;\\\\\\\\n                            match prefix {\\\\\\\\n                                Some(prefix) => push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                    function,\\\\\\\\n                                    budget,\\\\\\\\n                                    &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                    BuildFrame::Visit(prefix, start),\\\\\\\\n                                )?,\\\\\\\\n                                None => push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, start)?,\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ObservationDagKind::Cat(_) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, start)?;\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, 0),\\\\\\\\n                            )?;\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ObservationDagKind::Alt(members) => {\\\\\\\\n                   BuildFrame::Visit(member, start),\\\\\\\\n                                )?;\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Seq(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Seq(_, items) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence frame holds a sequence node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let prefix_end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence prefix end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, items.len(), \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let end = self.chain(function, budget, prefix_end, items)?;\\\\\\\\n                    memo_insert(function, budget, memo, key(dag, start), end)?;\\\\\\\\n                    push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, end)?;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, index) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Cat(parts) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation frame holds a concatenation node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation part end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    match parts.get(index) {\\\\\\\\n                        Some(part) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, index + 1),\\\\\\\\n                            )?;\\\\\\\\n   BuildFrame::Visit(part, end),\\\\\\\\n                            )?;\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        None => {\\\\\\\\n   }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Alt(dag, start, count) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let join = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    for _ in }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_plan(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        success: usize,\\\\\\\\n        failure: usize,\\\\\\\\n        latch: usize,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            plan_structure_units(plan),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored cleanup-plan automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n )?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(plan.blocks.len());\\\\\\\\n        for _ in &plan.blocks {\\\\\\\\n            entries.push(self.node(function, budget)?);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        let entry = |block: BlockId| entries[block.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n        for (index, block) in plan.blocks.iter().enumerate() {\\\\\\\\n            let mut node =          let next = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, next)?;\\\\\\\\n                    node = next;\\\\\\\\n &edge.condition)?;\\\\\\\\n                        self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, entry(edge.to))?;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                      success\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\\\\\n The private cache codec deliberately preserves the former Type wire\\\\\\\\n/// and node/depth accounting; the box owns no additional semantic authority.\\\\\\\\n#[repr(transparent)]\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]\\\\\\\\npub struct ResolvedResidualType(Box<ResolvedType>);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nimpl ResolvedResidualType {\\\\\\\\n    // Full box backing plus conservative receiving controls: two Option<Self>\\\\\\\\n    // results, two Self carriers, Box pointer, incoming Type, debit and bool.\\\\\\\\n    // All are acquired before allocation, including on retry. Nested Type\\\\\\\\n    // backing was acquired by its existing producer and remains fully charged.\\\\\\\\n    pub(crate) const CONSTRUCTION_BYTES: usize = std::mem::size_of::<ResolvedType>()\\\\\\\\n        + 2 * std::mem::size_of::<Option<Self>>()\\\\\\\\n        + 2 * std::mem::size_of::<Self>()\\\\\\\\n        + std::mem::size_of::<Box<ResolvedType>>()\\\\\\\\n        + std::mem::size_of::<ResolvedType>()\\\\\\\\n        + std::mem::size_of::<usize>()\\\\\\\\n        + std::mem::size_of::<bool>();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Refuses before allocation if the current builder cannot fund the box.\\\\\\\\n    /// Without an active builder this has the ordinary owned HIR behavior.\\\\\\\\n    pub fn try_new(value: ResolvedType) -> Option<Self> {\\\\\\\\n        if !crate::bounded_output::reserve_active_required(Self::CONSTRUCTION_BYTES) {\\\\\\\\n            return None;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Some(Self(Box::new(value)))\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\nimpl std::ops::Deref for ResolvedResidualType {\\\\\\\\n    type Target = ResolvedType;\\\\\\\\n    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {\\\\\\\\n        &self.0\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\nimpl std::ops::DerefMut for ResolvedResidualType {\\\\\\\\n    fn deref_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Self::Target (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//! Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod borrowed_canonical;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod canonical_before;\\\\\\\\nmod canonical_shared;\\\\\\\\npub(super) mod copy_regions;\\\\\\\\nmod dag_memo;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod instrumentation;\\\\\\\\nmod storage;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nuse canonical_before::Receiver as Canonicalizer;\\\\\\\\nuse storage::{memo_insert, push_end, push_frame, reserve_transition_observation};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Representation crossover, independent of the admitted path/work limits.\\\\\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 256;\\\\\\\\n// Preserve the original broad factored domain and every original small-function\\\\\\\\n// enumeration cross-check. moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod )\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// `Some(equal)`, or `None` when a path multiplicity overflows.\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\npub(super) fn compare(\\\\\\\\n    program: &dyn      ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) => entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\\\\\n                            success\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { edge, .. } => {\\\\\\\\n                            let marker =\\\\\\\\n                                lexical_skeleton::plan_exit_observation(budget, function, exit.id)?\\\\\\\\n                                    .ok_or_else(|| {\\\\\\\\n edge.\\\\\\\\n                            // A lexical exit must never become an epsilon edge.\\\\\\\\n                            self.observation(\\\\\\\\n }\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(entry(plan.entry))\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one cleanup transition contributes, exactly as\\\\\\\\n/// the &CleanupTransition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition {\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize { at, destination }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {\\\\\\\\n            at, destination, ..\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Initialize {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, edge_observation(\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    condition: &EdgeCondition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<SkeletonObservation, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    Ok(match condition {\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, value) => SkeletonObservation::Boolean {\\\\\\\\n            expression: expression.clone(),\\\\\\\\n EdgeCondition::ArmSelected {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\\\\\n            arm,\\\\\\\\n            selected,\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::ArmSelected {\\\\\\\\n | ResolvedType::U8\\n                | ResolvedType::Usize\\n                | ResolvedType::F64,\\n            ) => OwnershipMode::Value,\\n            _ if self.consumes_arguments() => First wave (gated as one helper/import group):\\n//!\\n//! - `string_len(s: string) -> i64` borrows its operand for a read.\\n//! - `string_concat(a: string, b: string) -> string` consumes both operands\\n//!   by move and returns one new owned string.\\n//! - `string_is_empty(s: string) -> bool` borrows its operand for a read.\\n//!\\n//! The cleanup builder,\\n/// its independent replay, and every lowering derive this exact map.\\npub(crate) fn same_owner_concat_appends(\\n    function: &crate::hir::ResolvedFunction,\\n) -> std::collections::BTreeMap<crate::hir::ExpressionId, crate::hir::ExpressionId> {\\n    use crate::hir::{ResolvedExprKind, ResolvedStatement};\\n    let mut appends = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();\\n    let mut pending = vec![&function.body];\\n    while let Some(expression) = pending.pop() {\\n        if let ResolvedExprKind::Block { statements, .. }\\n        | ResolvedExprKind::VecConstructor { statements, .. } = &expression.kind\\n        {\\n            for statement in statements {\\n                if let ResolvedStatement::Assign {\\n                    binding,\\n                    field: None,\\n                    value,\\n                    ..\\n                } = statement\\n                {\\n                    if let (true, ResolvedExprKind::Call { args, .. }) =\\n                        (is_same_owner_concat_hir(value, &binding.id), &value.kind)\\n                    {\\n                        appends.insert(args[0].id.clone(), value.id.clone());\\n                    }\\n                }\\n            }\\n        }\\n        pending.extend(crate::interpreter::trace_child_expressions(expression));\\n    }\\n    appends\\n}\\n\\n/// The moving first-operand places of [`same_owner_concat_appends`].\\npub(crate) fn same_owner_concat_operands(\\n    function: &crate::hir::ResolvedFunction,\\n) -> std::collections::BTreeSet<crate::hir::ExpressionId> {\\n    same_owner_concat_appends(function).into_keys().collect()\\n}\\n\\n/// Cleanup order after a same-owner append publishes the next generation:\\n/// the binding keeps the position its previous generation held when it was\\n/// staged (`history`), so loop iterations and branch joins see one stable\\n/// initialization history. pending);\\n    }\\n    Ok(())\\n}\\n\\n/// Bytewise three-way order of `string_compare`.\\npub(crate) fn compare_bytes(left: &[u8], right: &[u8]) -> i64 {\\n    match left.cmp(right) {\\n        std::cmp::Ordering::Less => -1,\\n        std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => 0,\\n        std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => 1,\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n/// The shared byte semantics of `string_find`: the first offset at or after\\n/// `from` where `needle` occurs. An empty needle matches at `from`.\\npub(crate) fn find_bytes(text: &[u8], needle: &[u8], from: usize) -> Option<usize> {\\n    if from > text.len() {\\n        return None;\\n    }\\n    if needle.is_empty() {\\n        return Some(from);\\n    }\\n    text[from..]\\n        .windows(needle.len())\\n        .position(|window| window == needle)\\n        .map(|offset| from + offset)\\n}\\n\\n/// `string_to_i64`: an optional leading `-`, then one or more ASCII digits\\n/// and nothing else, within the i64 range. Everything else is `None`.\\npub(crate) fn parse_i64(text: &[u8]) -> Option<i64> {\\n    let (negative, digits) = match text.split_first() {\\n        Some((b'-', rest)) => (true, rest),\\n        _ => (false, text),\\n    };\\n    if digits.is_empty() {\\n        return None;\\n    }\\n    let mut value: i64 = 0;\\n    for byte in digits {\\n        if !byte.is_ascii_digit() {\\n            return None;\\n        }\\n        let digit = i64::from(byte - b'0');\\n        value = value.checked_mul(10)?;\\n        value = if negative {\\n            value.checked_sub(digit)?\\n        } else {\\n            value.checked_add(digit)?\\n        };\\n    }\\n    Some(value)\\n}\\n\\n/// ASCII whitespace for `string_trim`: space, tab, line feed, vertical tab,\\n/// form feed, and carriage return.\\npub(crate) fn is_text_whitespace(byte: u8) -> bool {\\n    matches!(byte, b' ' | b'\\\\t' | b'\\\\n' | 0x0b | 0x0c | b'\\\\r')\\n}\\n\\n/// The byte range `string_trim` keeps. Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\n//! Independent\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the resolved meaning from one analysis.\\\\n///\\\\n/// Warnings do not prevent resolution. Any source error fails closed before the\\\\n/// resolver runs, so invalid source cannot leak internal HIR diagnostics.\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\\\\npub struct Analysis {\\\\n    pub diagnostics: Vec<Diagnostic>,\\\\n    pub resolved: Option<ResolvedProgram>,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Verify source once and resolve it when only warnings remain.\\\\npub fn analyze(program: &Program) -> Analysis {\\\\n    let diagnostics = source_verify::verify(program);\\\\n    if diagnostics\\\\n        .iter()\\\\n        .any(|diagnostic| diagnostic.severity.is_error())\\\\n    {\\\\n        return Analysis {\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\n            resolved: None,\\\\n        };\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // The ordinary caller captures only its existing invocation ledger. A\\\\n    // setup-short compatibility call retains the original owned diagnostic\\\\n    // route; initial report setup is not claimed funded by this activation.\\\\n    if ordinary_identity::can_acquire() {\\\\n        match ordinary_identity::try_resolve_verified_compatible(program) {\\\\n            Ok(Ok((resolved, _))) => {\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\n                    resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\n                };\\\\n            }\\\\n            Ok(Err(diagnostics)) => {\\\\n                return Analysis else {\\\\n        return Ok(None);\\\\n    };\\\\n    Ok(Some(hir == plan))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nstruct BuiltComparison {\\\\n    automaton: Automaton,\\\\n    sink: usize,\\\\n    hir_root: usize,\\\\n    plan_root: usize,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Reconstruct both exact observation languages once, retaining every debit.\\\\n/// The exact strategy census borrows this same physical owner; it never\\\\n/// retries construction after choosing a representation.\\\\nfn build_comparison<'hir>(\\\\n    program: &'hir dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,\\\\n    function: &'hir ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    helpers: Option<&crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::ModuleIndex<'hir>>,\\\\n    continuations: Option<&mut continuation_storage::Storage<'hir>>,\\\\n) -> Result<BuiltComparison, Diagnostic> {\\\\n    // Both independent constructors debit skeleton helpers as well as ordinary\\\\n    // constructors. allowance. Successful debits from either\\\\n    // constructor remain spent, including an attempt ending in refusal.\\\\n    budget.merge_paths = false;\\\\n    budget.lent_skeleton = false;\\\\n result.is_ok() {\\\\n            \\\\\\\"constructed\\\\\\\"\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            \\\\\\\"constructor refusal\\\\\\\"\\\\n        },\\\\n        None,\\\\n    );\\\\n    result\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[path = \\\\\\\"factored/strategy.rs\\\\\\\"]\\\\npub(super) mod strategy;\\\\n\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\nstruct Automaton {\\\\n    nodes: Vec<Node>,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nenum Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the {\\\\n                    let next = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\n                    self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, next)?;\\\\n                    node = next;\\\\n                }\\\\n            }\\\\n            match &block.terminator {\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Goto(edge) => {\\\\n                    let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];\\\\n                    let to = entry(edge.to);\\\\n                    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { .. } = &edge.condition {\\\\n                        let observation = edge_observation(function, budget, node, to)?;\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {\\\\n                    for edge in edges {\\\\n                        let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];\\\\n                        let observation = edge_observation(function, budget, &edge.condition)?;\\\\n                        self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, entry(edge.to))?;\\\\n                    }\\\\n                }\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit) => {\\\\n                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit.0 as usize];\\\\n                    let target = match &exit.continuation {\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) => entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\n                            success\\\\n                        }\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn {     .ok_or_else(|| {\\\\n                                        replay_error(\\\\n                                    function,\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\"factored lexical exit                              budget,\\\\n                                        function,\\\\n                                        target,\\\\n                                        \\\\\\\"factored loop-latch target clone\\\\\\\",\\\\n                                    )?,\\\\n                                },\\\\n                            };\\\\n }\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        Ok(entry(plan.entry))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one cleanup transition contributes, exactly as\\\\n/// the enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\nfn transition_observation(\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    transition: &CleanupTransition,\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition {\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize {     binding: binding.clone(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Transfer {\\\\n            at,\\\\n            source,\\\\n            destination,\\\\n        }\\\\n        | else {\\\\n        return Ok(None);\\\\n    };\\\\n    Ok(Some(hir == plan))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nstruct BuiltComparison {\\\\n    automaton: Automaton,\\\\n    sink: usize,\\\\n    hir_root: usize,\\\\n    plan_root: usize,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// Reconstruct both exact observation languages once, retaining every debit.\\\\n/// The exact strategy census borrows this same physical owner; it never\\\\n/// retries construction after choosing a representation.\\\\nfn build_comparison<'hir>(\\\\n    program: &'hir dyn crate::cleanup::ReplayContext,\\\\n    function: &'hir ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    helpers: Option<&crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::ModuleIndex<'hir>>,\\\\n    continuations: Option<&mut continuation_storage::Storage<'hir>>,\\\\n) -> Result<BuiltComparison, Diagnostic> {\\\\n    // Both independent constructors debit skeleton helpers as well as ordinary\\\\n    // constructors. deferred attempt.\\\\n    #[cfg(test)]\\\\n    instrumentation::begin(function, budget);\\\\n    let skeleton_reserve = budget.skeleton_remaining;\\\\n    budget.skeleton_remaining = hir_skeleton_paths_with_index_storage(\\\\n            program,\\\\n            function,\\\\n            budget,\\\\n            helpers,\\\\n            continuations,\\\\n        );\\\\n  SkeletonTerminal::Success => success,\\\\n                SkeletonTerminal::Failure => failure,\\\\n                SkeletonTerminal::LoopLatch => latch,\\\\n            };\\\\n     Ok(BuiltComparison {\\\\n            automaton,\\\\n            sink,\\\\n            hir_root,\\\\n            plan_root,\\\\n        })\\\\n    })();\\\\n    // Restore only the unused allowance. Successful debits from either\\\\n    // constructor remain spent, including an attempt ending in refusal.\\\\n    budget.merge_paths = false;\\\\n    budget.lent_skeleton = false;\\\\n    budget.remaining = std::mem::replace(&mut budget.skeleton_remaining, skeleton_reserve);\\\\n    #[cfg(test)]\\\\n    instrumentation::phase(\\\\n        function,\\\\n        budget,\\\\n        if result.is_ok() {\\\\n            \\\\\\\"constructed\\\\\\\"\\\\n        } else {\\\\n            \\\\\\\"constructor refusal\\\\\\\"\\\\n        },\\\\n        None,\\\\n    );\\\\n    result\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n#[path = \\\\\\\"factored/strategy.rs\\\\\\\"]\\\\npub(super) mod strategy;\\\\n\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\nstruct Automaton {\\\\n    nodes: Vec<Node>,\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nenum Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\n//! Independent\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\n//!\\\\n//! (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod borrowed_canonical;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod canonical_before;\\\\nmod canonical_shared;\\\\npub(super) mod copy_regions;\\\\nmod dag_memo;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nmod instrumentation;\\\\nmod storage;\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\nuse canonical_before::Receiver as Canonicalizer;\\\\nuse storage::{memo_insert, push_end, push_frame, reserve_transition_observation};\\\\n\\\\n/// Representation crossover, independent of the admitted path/work limits.\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 256;\\\\n// Preserve the original broad factored domain and every original small-function\\\\n// enumeration cross-check. add_plan(\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\n        success: usize,\\\\n        failure: usize,\\\\n        latch: usize,\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\n        let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\n            function,\\\\n            plan_structure_units(plan),\\\\n            \\\\\\\"factored cleanup-plan automaton\\\\\\\",\\\\n        )?;\\\\n        budget.reserve_array::<usize>(\\\\n            function,\\\\n            plan.blocks.len(),\\\\n            \\\\\\\"factored plan block entries\\\\\\\",\\\\n        )?;\\\\n        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(plan.blocks.len());\\\\n        for _ in &plan.blocks {\\\\n         let mut node = entries[index];\\\\n            for transition in &block.transitions {\\\\n                if let Some(observation) = transition_observation(function, budget, transition)? usize].to),\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\n                            success\\\\n                        }\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn {     .ok_or_else(|| {\\\\n                                        replay_error(\\\\n                                    function,\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\"factored lexical exit }\\\\n            }\\\\n        }\\\\n        Ok(entry(plan.entry))\\\\n    }\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one cleanup transition contributes, exactly as\\\\n/// the enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\nfn transition_observation(\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\n    transition: &CleanupTransition,\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition {\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize {      destination: destination.clone(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, binding } => SkeletonObservation::ReserveRenewal {\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\n            binding: binding.clone(),\\\\n        },\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Transfer {\\\\n            at,\\\\n            source,\\\\n            destination,\\\\n        }\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { source } => {\\\\n            SkeletonObservation::StageCopyResult(CopySource::new(function, budget, source.clone())?)\\\\n        }\\\\n        CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase { .. }\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. } => return Ok(None),\\\\n    }))\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one edge condition (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//! moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod reserve_transition_observation};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Path count above which the factored comparison replaces enumeration.\\\\\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 4_096;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]\\\\\\\\nenum Label {\\\\\\\\n    Observation(Rc<SkeletonObservation>),\\\\\\\\n    End(SkeletonTerminal),\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\\\\\nstruct Node {\\\\\\\\n    moves: Vec<(Label, usize)>,\\\\\\\\n    epsilon: Vec<usize>,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// {\\\\\\\\n    if cfg_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD && semantic_paths <= FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD {\\\\\\\\n        return Ok(false);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    match structural_control::validate_ordinary_cfg(function, budget) {\\\\\\\\n        Ok(()) => Ok(true),\\\\\\\\n        Err(error) if budget.refusal_spent || crate::bounded_output::active_refused() => Err(error),\\\\\\\\n        Err(_) => Ok(false),\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n/// `true` when this function's typed-control skeleton is compared factored.\\\\\\\\n/// semantic_paths: usize,\\\\\\\\n) -> bool {\\\\\\\\n    (cfg_paths > FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD || semantic_paths > FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD)\\\\\\\\n        && \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"HIR skeleton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            hir_paths.as_ref().map(|paths| paths.as_slice()).ok(),\\\\\\\\n        );\\\\\\\\n        let hir_paths =          hir_root,\\\\\\\\n            plan_root,\\\\\\\\n        })\\\\\\\\n    })();\\\\\\\\n    // Restore only the unused allowance. \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"constructor refusal\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    result\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[path = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored/strategy.rs\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"]\\\\\\\\npub(super) mod strategy;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\\\\\nstruct Automaton {\\\\\\\\n    nodes:      budget.reserve_vec(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            &mut self.nodes[from].epsilon,\\\\\\\\n            1,\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored automaton epsilon    fn end(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n        sink: usize,\\\\\\\\n        terminal: SkeletonTerminal,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let node = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        self.movement(function, budget, node, Label::End(terminal), sink)?;\\\\\\\\n        Ok(node)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn chain(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n        mut end: usize,\\\\\\\\n        items: &[Rc<SkeletonObservation>],\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        for item in items {\\\\\\\\n            let next = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n            self.movement(\\\\\\\\n                function,\\\\\\\\n                budget,\\\\\\\\n                end,\\\\\\\\n                Label::Observation(item.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                next,\\\\\\\\n            )?;\\\\\\\\n            end = next;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(end)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Build `observations` forward from `start` and return its end node.\\\\\\\\n    /// A shared DAG node is built once per start node, so a merged prefix\\\\\\\\n    /// that many later paths extend exists once in the automaton.\\\\\\\\n    fn add_observations(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        observations: &Observations,\\\\\\\\n        start: usize,\\\\\\\\n        memo: &mut dag_memo::Memo,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let (prefix, items) = observations.parts();\\\\\\\\n        let mut end = start;\\\\\\\\n        if let Some(prefix) = prefix {\\\\\\\\n            end = self.add_dag(function, prefix, start, memo, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            items.len().saturating_add(1),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        self.chain(function, budget, end, items)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_dag(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        root: &Rc<ObservationDag>,\\\\\\\\n        start: usize,\\\\\\\\n        memo: &mut dag_memo::Memo,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let key = dag_memo::key;\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_array::<BuildFrame<'_>>(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored DAG initial frame\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut frames = vec![BuildFrame::Visit(root, start)];\\\\\\\\n        let mut ends = Vec::<usize>::new();\\\\\\\\n        while let Some(frame) = frames.pop() {\\\\\\\\n            match frame {\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Visit(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let retained = dag_memo::get(function, memo, &key(dag, start), budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    #[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\n                    instrumentation::visit(dag, retained.is_some());\\\\\\\\n                    if let Some(end) = retained {\\\\\\\\n                        push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, end)?;\\\\\\\\n                        continue;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                    match &dag.kind {\\\\\\\\n                        ObservationDagKind::Seq(prefix, _) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(function, budget, &mut frames, BuildFrame::Seq(dag,                           budget,\\\\\\\\n                                    &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                    BuildFrame::Visit(prefix, start),\\\\\\\\n                                )?,\\\\\\\\n                                None => push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, start)?,\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ObservationDagKind::Cat(_) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, start)?;\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start,                   BuildFrame::Visit(member, start),\\\\\\\\n                                )?;\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Seq(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Seq(_, items) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence frame holds a sequence node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let prefix_end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence prefix end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, items.len(), \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let end = self.chain(function, budget, prefix_end, items)?;\\\\\\\\n                    memo_insert(function, budget, memo, key(dag, start), end)?;\\\\\\\\n                    push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, end)?;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, index) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Cat(parts) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation frame holds a concatenation node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation part end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    match parts.get(index) {\\\\\\\\n                        Some(part) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                &mut frames,\\\\\\\\n                                BuildFrame::Cat(dag, start, index + 1),\\\\\\\\n                            )?;\\\\\\\\n join)?;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored DAG build produced an end\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"))\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_plan(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        success: usize,\\\\\\\\n        failure: usize,\\\\\\\\n        latch: usize,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            plan_structure_units(plan),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored cleanup-plan automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_array::<usize>(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            plan.blocks.len(),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored plan block entries\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(plan.blocks.len());\\\\\\\\n        for _ in &plan.blocks {\\\\\\\\n            entries.push(self.node(function, budget)?);\\\\\\\\n          let next = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, next)?;\\\\\\\\n                    node = next;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            match &block.terminator {\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Goto(edge) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n                    let to = entry(edge.to);\\\\\\\\n                    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { .. } = &edge.condition {\\\\\\\\n                        let observation =               self.epsilon(function, budget, node, to)?;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {\\\\\\\\n &edge.condition)?;\\\\\\\\n                        self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, entry(edge.to))?;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n                    let target = match &exit.continuation {\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) => entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\\\\\n                            success\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { edge, .. } => {\\\\\\\\n                            let marker =\\\\\\\\n                                lexical_skeleton::plan_exit_observation(budget, function, exit.id)?\\\\\\\\n                                    .ok_or_else(|| {\\\\\\\\n                                        replay_error(\\\\\\\\n                                    function,\\\\\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored lexical exit lacks an exact certificate marker\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n                                )\\\\\\\\n                                    })?;\\\\\\\\n                            // The marker itself is the labelled continuation edge.\\\\\\\\n                            // A lexical exit must never become an epsilon edge.\\\\\\\\n                            self.observation(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n                                node,\\\\\\\\n                                marker,\\\\\\\\n                                entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\\\\\n                            )?;\\\\\\\\n                            continue;\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n lexical_cert::latch_resume(plan, exit.id).map_or(latch, entry);\\\\\\\\n                            self.observation(function, budget, node, marker, target)?;\\\\\\\\n }\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(entry(plan.entry))\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one cleanup transition contributes, exactly as\\\\\\\\n/// the enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\\\\\nfn transition_observation(\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    transition: &CleanupTransition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition {\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize { at, destination }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {\\\\\\\\n            at, destination, ..\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Initialize {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at, binding } => SkeletonObservation::ReserveRenewal {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            binding: binding.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Transfer source,\\\\\\\\n            destination,\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::TransferVariant {\\\\\\\\n            at,\\\\\\\\n            source,\\\\\\\\n            destination,\\\\\\\\n            ..\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Transfer {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, arguments } => SkeletonObservation::CallCommit {\\\\\\\\n            call:    .collect(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { source } => {\\\\\\\\n            SkeletonObservation::StageCopyResult(CopySource::new(function, budget, source.clone())?)\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase { .. }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. } => return Ok(None),\\\\\\\\n    }))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one edge condition contributes, exactly as the\\\\\\\\n/// enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\\\\\nfn edge_observation(\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    condition: &EdgeCondition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<SkeletonObservation, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    Ok(match condition {\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, value) => SkeletonObservation::Boolean {\\\\\\\\n            expression: expression.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            value: *value,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::VariantCase {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\\\\\n            case,\\\\\\\\n            matches,\\\\\\\\n        } => Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod borrowed_canonical;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod canonical_before;\\\\\\\\nmod canonical_shared;\\\\\\\\npub(super) mod copy_regions;\\\\\\\\nmod dag_memo;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod instrumentation;\\\\\\\\nmod storage;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nuse canonical_before::Receiver as Canonicalizer;\\\\\\\\nuse storage::{memo_insert, push_end, push_frame, reserve_transition_observation};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Representation crossover, independent of the admitted path/work limits.\\\\\\\\nconst FACTORED_PATH_THRESHOLD: usize = 256;\\\\\\\\n// Preserve the original broad factored domain and every original small-function\\\\\\\\n// enumeration cross-check. {\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Initialize { at, destination }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::InitializeVariant {\\\\\\\\n            at, destination, ..\\\\\\\\n        } => binding } => SkeletonObservation::ReserveRenewal {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            binding: binding.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::Transfer {\\\\\\\\n            at,\\\\\\\\n            source,\\\\\\\\n            destination,\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::Renew {\\\\\\\\n            at,\\\\\\\\n            source,\\\\\\\\n            destination,\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::TransferVariant {\\\\\\\\n            at,\\\\\\\\n            source,\\\\\\\\n            destination,\\\\\\\\n            ..\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::Transfer {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::CallCommit { call, arguments } => SkeletonObservation::CallCommit {\\\\\\\\n            call: call.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            arguments: arguments\\\\\\\\n                .iter()\\\\\\\\n                .map(|argument| (argument.parameter_index, argument.source.clone()))\\\\\\\\n                .collect(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::StageCopyResult { source } => {\\\\\\\\n            SkeletonObservation::StageCopyResult(CopySource::new(function, budget, source.clone())?)\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::AuthenticateVariantCase { .. }\\\\\\\\n        | CleanupTransition::SelectFailure { .. } => return Ok(None),\\\\\\\\n    }))\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The skeleton observation one edge condition contributes, exactly as the\\\\\\\\n/// enumerating `plan_skeleton_paths` records it.\\\\\\\\nfn edge_observation(\\\\\\\\n    function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n    budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    condition: &EdgeCondition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<SkeletonObservation, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    Ok(match condition {\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::BooleanResult(expression, value) => SkeletonObservation::Boolean {\\\\\\\\n            expression: expression.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            value: *value,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::VariantCase {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\\\\\n            case,\\\\\\\\n            matches,\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::VariantCase {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee: scrutinee.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            case: case.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            matches: *matches,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::ArmSelected {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee,\\\\\\\\n            arm,\\\\\\\\n            selected,\\\\\\\\n        } => SkeletonObservation::ArmSelected {\\\\\\\\n            scrutinee: scrutinee.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            arm: *arm,\\\\\\\\n            selected: *selected,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::StatusZero(source) => SkeletonObservation::Status {\\\\\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            success: true,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::StatusNonzero(source) => SkeletonObservation::Status {\\\\\\\\n            source: source.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            success: false,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        EdgeCondition::Always => {\\\\\\\\n            return Err(replay_error(\\\\\\\\n                function,\\\\\\\\n                \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"branch skeleton contains an unconditional edge\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n            ));\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// A weighted set of automaton nodes: each node with the number of distinct\\\\\\\\n/// automaton paths that reach it on one observation moderate_tests;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\\n        \\\\\\\"before\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"//! Factored typed-control skeleton comparison.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! The enumerating comparison materializes every terminal path of the typed\\\\\\\\n//! HIR and of the cleanup CFG and compares the sorted multisets. Independent\\\\\\\\n//! decisions in sequence multiply that count (2^N for N independent `if`s,\\\\\\\\n//! `&&` operands, or scalar `match`es), although a decision that leaves the\\\\\\\\n//! cleanup state unchanged contributes nothing a single path would not.\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! This module decides the same multiset equality without enumerating the\\\\\\\\n//! product:\\\\\\\\n//!\\\\\\\\n//! * The typed-HIR skeleton is derived by the unchanged walk with path-state\\\\\\\\n//!   merging enabled: whenever paths are sequenced, paths whose cleanup state\\\\\\\\n//!   (owned source, failure, residual, and call commit list) is identical are\\\\\\\\n//!   merged into one path carrying the union of their observation sequences.\\\\\\\\n//!   Every later skeleton step reads only that state, so the merged walk\\\\\\\\n//!   denotes exactly the enumerated paths, and its size follows the number of\\\\\\\\n//!   distinct cleanup states rather than the number of decision combinations.\\\\\\\\n//!   Lexical functions restrict those merges to independently identified Copy\\\\\\\\n//!   expression scopes; every abrupt/failure/owning state remains separate.\\\\\\\\n//! * Both the merged HIR paths and the cleanup CFG become acyclic automata\\\\\\\\n//!   over skeleton observations, each accepting sequence ending in one\\\\\\\\n//!   terminal label.\\\\\\\\n//! * Bottom-up hash-consing of the weighted subset construction assigns two\\\\\\\\n//!   states the same id exactly when they accept every sequence the same\\\\\\\\n//!   number of times, so equal roots prove equal path multisets.\\\\\\\\nuse super::skeleton_work::{ObservationDag, ObservationDagKind};\\\\\\\\nuse super::*;\\\\\\\\nuse std::rc::Rc;\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"constructor refusal\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        None,\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n    result\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[path = Label::Observation(item.clone()),\\\\\\\\n                next,\\\\\\\\n            )?;\\\\\\\\n            end = next;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        Ok(end)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    /// Build `observations` forward from `start` and return its end node.\\\\\\\\n    /// A shared DAG node is built once per start node, so a merged prefix\\\\\\\\n    /// that many later paths extend exists once in the automaton.\\\\\\\\n    fn add_observations(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        observations: &Observations,\\\\\\\\n observations.parts();\\\\\\\\n        let mut end = start;\\\\\\\\n        if let Some(prefix) = prefix {\\\\\\\\n            end = self.add_dag(function, prefix, start, memo, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            items.len().saturating_add(1),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n        )?;\\\\\\\\n        self.chain(function, budget, end, items)\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_dag(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n     let key = dag_memo::key;\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_array::<BuildFrame<'_>>(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored DAG initial frame\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n        let mut frames = vec![BuildFrame::Visit(root, start)];\\\\\\\\n        let mut ends = Vec::<usize>::new();\\\\\\\\n        while let Some(frame) = frames.pop() {\\\\\\\\n            match frame {\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Visit(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, 1, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let retained =         )?,\\\\\\\\n                                None => push_end(function, budget, &mut ends, start)?,\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                   BuildFrame::Visit(member, start),\\\\\\\\n                                )?;\\\\\\\\n                            }\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                BuildFrame::Seq(dag, start) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let ObservationDagKind::Seq(_, items) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence frame holds a sequence node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let prefix_end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"sequence prefix end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    budget.charge(function, items.len(), \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored HIR automaton\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n                    let end = self.chain(function, budget, prefix_end, items)?;\\\\\\\\n                    memo_insert(function, budget, memo, key(dag, start), let ObservationDagKind::Cat(parts) = &dag.kind else {\\\\\\\\n                        unreachable!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation frame holds a concatenation node\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    };\\\\\\\\n                    let end = ends.pop().expect(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"concatenation part end retained\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\");\\\\\\\\n                    match parts.get(index) {\\\\\\\\n                        Some(part) => {\\\\\\\\n                            push_frame(\\\\\\\\n                                function,\\\\\\\\n                                budget,\\\\\\\\n }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn add_plan(\\\\\\\\n        &mut self,\\\\\\\\n        function: &ResolvedFunction,\\\\\\\\n        success: usize,\\\\\\\\n        failure: usize,\\\\\\\\n        latch: usize,\\\\\\\\n        budget: &mut ReplayBudget,\\\\\\\\n    ) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n        let plan = &function.cleanup_plan;\\\\\\\\n        budget.charge(\\\\\\\\n budget.reserve_array::<usize>(\\\\\\\\n            function,\\\\\\\\n            plan.blocks.len(),\\\\\\\\n            \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored plan block entries\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n          let next = self.node(function, budget)?;\\\\\\\\n                    self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, next)?;\\\\\\\\n                    node = next;\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            match &block.terminator {\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Goto(edge) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as               self.epsilon(function, budget, node, to)?;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Branch(edges) => {\\\\\\\\n                    for edge in edges {\\\\\\\\n                        let edge = &plan.edges[edge.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n                        let observation = edge_observation(function, budget, &edge.condition)?;\\\\\\\\n                        self.observation(function, budget, node, observation, entry(edge.to))?;\\\\\\\\n                    }\\\\\\\\n                }\\\\\\\\n                CleanupTerminator::Exit(exit) => {\\\\\\\\n                    let exit = &plan.exits[exit.0 as usize];\\\\\\\\n                    let target = match &exit.continuation {\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::Continue(edge) => entry(plan.edges[edge.0 as usize].to),\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::CommitResult { .. } | ExitContinuation::ReturnUnit => {\\\\\\\\n                            success\\\\\\\\n                        }\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::ReturnFailure { .. } => failure,\\\\\\\\n                        ExitContinuation::LoopBreak { edge, .. }\\\\\\\\n                        | ExitContinuation::FunctionReturn { edge, .. } => {\\\\\\\\n                            let marker =\\\\\\\\n                                lexical_skeleton::plan_exit_observation(budget, function, exit.id)?\\\\\\\\n                                    .ok_or_else(|| {\\\\\\\\n                                        replay_error(\\\\\\\\n                                    function,\\\\\\\\n                                    \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored lexical exit lacks an exact certificate lexical_cert::latch_resume(plan, exit.id).map_or(latch, entry);\\\\\\\\n                            self.observation(function, budget, node, marker, target)?;\\\\\\\\n &CleanupTransition,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<Option<SkeletonObservation>, Diagnostic> {\\\\\\\\n    reserve_transition_observation(function, budget, transition)?;\\\\\\\\n    Ok(Some(match transition SkeletonObservation::Initialize {\\\\\\\\n            at: at.clone(),\\\\\\\\n            destination: destination.clone(),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        CleanupTransition::ReserveRenewal { at,    if let EdgeCondition::VariantCase { case, .. } = condition {\\\\\\\\n        budget.reserve_clone(function, case, \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"factored edge case identity\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")?;\\\\\\\\n A\\\\\\\\n    // setup-short compatibility call retains the original owned diagnostic\\\\\\\\n    // route; initial report setup is not claimed funded by this activation.\\\\\\\\n    if ordinary_identity::can_acquire() {\\\\\\\\n        match ordinary_identity::try_resolve_verified_compatible(program) {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Ok((resolved, _))) => {\\\\\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n                    resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n                };\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Err(diagnostics)) => Err(_) => {} // Legacy setup-only diagnostic compatibility below.\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    match resolve_verified(program, None) {\\\\\\\\n        Ok((resolved, _)) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n            resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        Err(diagnostic) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            // Preserve `resolve`'s resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn hir_error(message: impl Into<String>) -> Diagnostic {\\\\\\\\n .chain(&function.ensures)\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        inspection::visit_resolved_calls(expression, &mut |callee, _, _| {\\\\\\\\n            requires |= source.functions().iter().any(|target| });\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    requires\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[cfg(test)]\\\\\\\\nmod function_reuse_environment_tests {\\\\\\\\n    use super::*;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    fn ProgramSource,\\\\\\\\n) -> Result<(ResolvedProgram, FunctionResolutionWork), Vec<Diagnostic>> {\\\\\\\\n    (Resolver {\\\\\\\\n        program,\\\\\\\\n        byte_helpers: vec![error])\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Resolve a verified program. clause_program.is_some() {\\\\\\\\n            None\\\\\\\\n        } else {\\\\\\\\n            reuse\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        function_work: FunctionResolutionWork::default(),\\\\\\\\n        fused_producer: None,\\\\\\\\n        partition_profile: false,\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n    .resolve()?;\\\\\\\\n    let Some(desugared) = record_invariants::desugar(program, &resolved.0) else crate::loop_calls::byte_writer::SourceIndex::new(&desugared),\\\\\\\\n        declarations: DeclarationIndex::from_verified(&desugared)?,\\\\\\\\n        reuse: None,\\\\\\\\n        function_work: FunctionResolutionWork::default(),\\\\\\\\n        fused_producer: None,\\\\\\\\n        partition_profile: false,\\\\\\\\n    })\\\\\\\\n    .resolve()\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Default)]\\\\\\\\npub(crate) struct FunctionResolutionWork {\\\\\\\\n    costs: BTreeMap<String, usize>,\\\\\\\\n    reused: usize,\\\\\\\\n }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// The source diagnostics and optional resolved meaning from one analysis.\\\\\\\\n///\\\\\\\\n/// Warnings do not prevent resolution. Any source error fails closed before the\\\\\\\\n/// resolver runs, so invalid source cannot leak internal HIR diagnostics.\\\\\\\\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\\\\\\\\npub struct Analysis {\\\\\\\\n    pub diagnostics: Vec<Diagnostic>,\\\\\\\\n    pub resolved: Option<ResolvedProgram>,\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/// Verify source once and resolve it when only warnings remain.\\\\\\\\npub fn analyze(program: &Program) -> Analysis {\\\\\\\\n    let diagnostics = source_verify::verify(program);\\\\\\\\n    if diagnostics\\\\\\\\n        .iter()\\\\\\\\n        .any(|diagnostic| diagnostic.severity.is_error())\\\\\\\\n    {\\\\\\\\n        return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n            resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // The ordinary caller captures only its existing invocation ledger. A\\\\\\\\n    // setup-short compatibility call retains the original owned diagnostic\\\\\\\\n    // route; initial report setup is not claimed funded by this activation.\\\\\\\\n    if ordinary_identity::can_acquire() {\\\\\\\\n        match ordinary_identity::try_resolve_verified_compatible(program) {\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Ok((resolved, _))) => {\\\\\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n                    resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n                };\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            Ok(Err(diagnostics)) => {\\\\\\\\n                return Analysis {\\\\\\\\n                    diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n                    resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n                };\\\\\\\\n            }\\\\\\\\n            Err(_) => {} // Legacy setup-only diagnostic compatibility below.\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    match resolve_verified(program, None) {\\\\\\\\n        Ok((resolved, _)) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics,\\\\\\\\n            resolved: Some(resolved),\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n        Err(diagnostic) => Analysis {\\\\\\\\n            // Preserve `resolve`'s established invariant-failure behavior: an\\\\\\\\n            // internal HIR diagnostic replaces otherwise non-fatal warnings.\\\\\\\\n            diagnostics: vec![diagnostic],\\\\\\\\n            resolved: None,\\\\\\\\n        },\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nfn hir_error(message: impl Into<String>) -> Diagnostic {\\\\\\\\n Diagnostic::io_static(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"SPX-H006\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", message)\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nstruct FunctionReuse<'a> {\\\\\\\\n    // The environment proof belongs to this exact current source
